prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a narrow, fog-laden path flanked by tall, leafless trees and a wooden fence on the right side. The camera moves smoothly, capturing the misty atmosphere that envelops the scene, reducing visibility and casting a muted, grayish hue over the surroundings. As the viewer progresses, the path curves gently to the left, revealing more of the dense forest on either side, with the fog thickening further into the distance. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive experience of walking through this serene yet eerie landscape. The ground is damp and scattered with fallen leaves, adding texture to the path. Gradually, the path leads towards a rustic wooden building partially obscured by the fog, its warm light spilling out from a small window, creating a stark contrast against the cool, misty environment. The camera continues to move forward, approaching the building, which appears to be a traditional structure with a sloped roof and a small porch. The overall ambiance is quiet and isolated, with no other figures or sounds disrupting the tranquil, foggy setting. The lighting remains consistently soft and diffused due to the overcast sky, enhancing the sense of solitude and mystery in this outdoor natural scene.
